{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Nagai_telepath.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] telepath.]]
{{Quote|Jaden&hellip;don't do it.|[[Kyle Katarn]] using telepathy to prevent [[Jaden Korr]] from turning to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]|<ref name="JKJA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>}}
'''Telepathy''' was the [[Force power/Legends|Force ability]] to read and interact with other minds, mentally communicate and project the user's thoughts over small or vast distances with other individuals.

==Description==
{{Quote|Master Tiin&mdash;you're the telepath. What am I thinking right now?|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], to [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], just before killing him|<ref name="ROTS novelization">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith'' (novelization)]]</ref>}}
Every [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|user]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], was potentially able to use this ability. The range of telepathy itself is theoretically infinite, with enough power and understanding, but the telepath often had to be able to sense the presences of those they wish to contact and/or choose where to hurl the communication. Thus, communicating with non-Force-sensitives became nearly impossible over distances greater than a handful of kilometers, and the typical upper limit for Force-sensitives was approximately 1,000 kilometers. However, individuals who either shared a biological relationship or a particularly strong emotional bond were known to communicate across far greater ranges. In extreme cases (such as the twin bond between [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]), the link apparently had no spacial limit.

While often used for Force users to communicate with each other, telepathy could be used to contact non-Force-sensitives.<ref>[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]</ref><ref name="ROTS novelization">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith'' (novelization)]]</ref> Even sometimes to speak words into their minds.<ref>[[Star Wars (1998) 39|''Star Wars'' (1998) 39]]</ref>

[[File:SaeseeTiin-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|Iktotchi were a telepathic species]]
The telepathy of most Force-sensitive individuals was not potent enough to truly read the thoughts of other beings, and could only sense the emotions or general mindset of those around them. This form of basic telepathy was more commonly known as [[Force empathy/Legends|Force empathy]]. While every Force-adept was able to use telepathy to some degree, very few of them were actually skilled enough to participate in actual telepathic conversations. Most Force-sensitive individuals could only exchange short four or five-word sentences to those that they shared close bonds with. Usually, Jedi employed telepathy only to read the states of minds or engage in silent communication. Eye contact, in part, allowed a user to have less difficulty in focusing on a target's thoughts. A very skilled user could create a telepathic shield to isolate their own brain waves, intercept stray thoughts, screen multiple minds simultaneously, whisper across space, yell without noise, keep secrets, and uncover the truths under layers of deceits and hidden memories. Adept pilots could even be able to seek information from other stars so as to navigate a starship through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] without use of a [[Navigation computer/Legends|nav computer]]. Moreover, telepathy also gave its user an advantage in combat, as it could be used to predict the next movement of an opponent,<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> and furthermore to taunt and confuse opponents by echoing their voice in their head in every direction, masking the user's position.

Telepathy through the Force could also be utilized to more intrusively interact with the minds of others. A most common example was the [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]], which allowed a Force-user to influence or even fully control another's thoughts, behavior, and actions. A skilled and powerful enough Force-user could even [[Memory rub/Legends|alter or erase the memories]] of a subject. Another telepathic ability was to project a telepathic blast to harm the target's mind, as well as painfully extract information from a person's mind, also known as Mind Probe. The technique [[Dun Möch/Legends|Dun Möch]] could notably be implemented with telepathic attacks of varying degrees of intensity in order for a Force-user to gain an advantage in a duel.

[[Drain Knowledge]] was a technique that utilized telepathy in a violent manner, as it forcibly extracted information from the victim while potentially causing psychological damage. Similarly, [[Memory Walk]] was a technique that allowed a user to reach into the victim's mind, forcing them to repeatedly relive their most uncomfortable memories, and could potentially even cause physical pain. [[Neural Storm]] was a telepathic ability that used psychic energy to overload a victim's neural network, causing extreme but momentary disorientation.

[[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] were three of the most skilled Jedi telepaths during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Some [[Species/Legends|species]], such as the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]], the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]], the [[Hortek]], the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermians]], [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltrons]], [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]], and the [[Draethos/Legends|Draethos]], had evolved a natural telepathic ability, common even to those of their number who could not touch the Force. When trained as Jedi, their natural talents were often magnified a thousandfold or more. This was the case with Saesee Tiin, whose natural prowess in the ability caused him great discomfort during his years as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. It was not until he was trained by Jedi Master [[Omo Bouri/Legends|Omo Bouri]] that he learned to better control his telepathic sense.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force" /> Some [[Lamproid/Legends|Lamproids]] exhibited natural telepathy, although this was not a species-wide trait.<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>

[[File:Luke_bespin.jpg|thumb|right|180px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] using telepathy on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].]]
As telepathy was a very basic use of the Force, the relatively untrained [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was able to employ it to reach out to his twin sister [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and call for her help during the [[Occupation of Bespin]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] then (as Luke and the group were escaping) called out to Luke to again try to convince him to join him and embrace the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. The fact that the three were related allowed them to reach out over even greater distances.

Beings who could use telepathy were banned from most [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] in the galaxy, since they could get an unfair advantage and break the game.<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
